name: Judicial Council
jurisdiction: Union-wide legal oversight: appoints judges, arbitrates disputes, receives reports from the Chief Marshal of the Union Marshals.
promotion_note: Created 2026-07-20 at STAGING per owner ruling (reconciliation C5) to resolve ghost reference in the Marshals oversight model. Sourced from April-2025 'MAS - Glactic Union' thread.

design_open_questions.status: RESOLVED by Marshal Charter v0.1 Art. III (owner-approved promotion 2026-07-20)
items: power to suspend a Marshal operation
design_open_questions.related_body: High Judiciary & Galactic Tribunal (archive; interstellar law, war crimes, AI rights, authority over planetary courts) — relationship to this Council undefined

charter.composition: 9 jurists, fixed staggered terms (mirrors canonical GU leadership bench, engine F6)
charter.appointment: Chancellor nominates, Union Senate confirms (engine F2/F3: executive legitimacy volatile, Senate stable across all seeds)
charter.status: administrative-judicial oversight organ; trial/appeals at High Judiciary & Galactic Tribunal
charter.warrant_authority: duty magistrates issue Union warrants for Marshal overrides (Charter Art. I)
charter.suspension_power: 6-of-9 supermajority suspends a Marshal operation; Sentinel suspensions notify Senate
